name: Customizable Simple USB Cable Catcher / Desk Tidy

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable desk-edge cable catcher designed to clip onto the back of a desk. It consists of a long, thin rectangular main block featuring several small, evenly spaced vertical cylindrical guide slots along its back edge to hold cables. On both the far left and far right ends, pairs of flat rectangular tabs extend forward, creating U-shaped clamping brackets that slide over the top and bottom of the desk edge.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric OpenSCAD script for a desk-edge USB cable catcher. The model should feature a main rectangular body with customizable width, depth, and vertical slot spacing/diameters for holding cables, paired with top and bottom clamping tabs on both ends that can be adjusted to match the thickness of a desk.
captions.factory: The main body is created using a difference() operation on a cube of dimensions [fullWidth, depth, deskh + 2 * tabHeight]. A for-loop subtracts vertically oriented cylinders of diameter slotDiameter, translated by slotRecess and spaced by slotGap along the width. Four mounting tabs are constructed using cube() with dimensions [tabWidth, tabLength, tabHeight] and positioned at the bottom and top corners of the main body using translate() with negative Y offsets to protrude forward.
